title: stringify() sorts the caller's filter array in place when `sort` is also given
property: stringify does not mutate its input options (the filter array) when sort is supplied
property_test: filter array not mutated when sort given
expected: Output 'a=2&i=1' and the caller's filter array remains ['i','a']
actual: Output is sorted, but filter is mutated to ['a','i'] (objKeys = filter; objKeys.sort(...))
evidence: Top-level code does `objKeys = filter; ... objKeys.sort(options.sort)`, sorting the user's array. Inner recursion sorts a fresh Object.keys copy, so only the filter path leaks the mutation; a serializer is expected not to modify its options, and reusing one filter array across calls is the documented usage.
